parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is a handle of the bucket made of plastic, typically curved for easy gripping.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to carry the bucket comfortably by hand, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to the bucket body for flexible movement.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the second handle of the bucket, also made of plastic, designed for carrying support.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional support for carrying, often used together with the first handle for balance.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot around its hinge points, allowing it to fold down or stand upright.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, made of durable plastic and designed to hold contents.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for storing or carrying liquids or solids.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, providing structural support for the entire bucket.
